entry_item.definition: [= xumbi-] v.t. To fold ; to gather up ; to close tightly

example.definition: To close one's mouth tight, remain silent; to smile with closed lips.
To put the knees together when sitting or squatting; to squat on one's heels, kneel.
To close one's hand firmly, make a fist.

entry_item.definition: serrer fortement, plier, courber, jeter sur, dévider, bobiner; nouer; envelopper, entortiller; fermer
v.t. To gather together. To scoop together with both hands and arms, gathering grain or salt (in the saltlakes). To close a book.
〔动〕收拾，收起；整理，归整：хураах ~ 收拾；ажлаа ~ 收工；гараа ~ад суух 袖手旁观；хөлөө ~ (1)收起自己的腿；(2)停止行走；хормойгоо ~ 提起前襟；амаа ~ (1)讲话简洁；(2)住口；юм хум хумьж авах 整理东西；шувуу далбачаа хумив 鸟收拢了翅膀.
